name: Lake
desc:
Lake is a Chrysid NPC. She is a native of the [Lullaby Isles](location:lullaby_isles), specifically Daphnes, who got lost and somehow found herself in the [Songseeker Wilds](location:songseeker_wilds).

Lake somehow ended up in the [Eastern Luminant](location:luminants), wherein she encountered a band of sailors. Thinking the Songseeker Wilds were her home, she had them take her there. As she explored, she ran afoul of some [Songseekers](faction:songseeker).

She wears the Scholar Outfit.
additional_info:
-   Lake used to be sat on the broken bridge opposite the [Temple of the Forgotten Flame](location:the_temple_of_the_forgotten_flame).
